details:
An audio bug occurred while participating in a live event.

The bug caused the sound level meter to constantly swing out of sync and I could not hear the VRChat sound.

After rebooting, I was not able to enter in a full instance.

The problem is the audio bug.

Scope of Impact

All audio sources

I will never forgive them for ruining my enjoyment of the event.
title: Sound Bug The level meter is swinging out.
